483-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5189-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4-1170-7522.description:
Cast Stream of Life using the convoke ability from Hoarding Broodlord by tapping Infirmary Healer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Infirmary Healer, which enters prepared.
Resolve Stream of Life.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4659-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-7818.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1274-3197-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1580-4871-5147-6248.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-5457-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5457-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5457-6965.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

670-1619-1734-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6138.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from exile to the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

4222-4289-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

2469-5220-5933-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2376-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

7439-7440.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Crackle with Power by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to a set number of targets.
7439-7440.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal, and you'll also get more targets to deal damage to. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Crackle with Power.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3147-3259-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3147-3259-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Aang

1525-5361-6986-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
1525-5361-6986-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Leyline of Mutation and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
1525-5361-6986-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

3096-3832-4289.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

250-779-1315-1479-4862.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-4862.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

654-4693-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
654-4693-5721-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

413-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

1563-2457-3000-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

67-2511-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

730-880-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-880-6664.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-2438-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-2438-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1671-1741-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land
1671-1741-5900.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Simic Growth Chamber and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

112-4050-5851.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

304-643-1636.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
304-643-1636.description:
Activate Tough Cookie's first ability by paying {2}{G}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1437-1558-5184-5401.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least one indestructible counter on it.
Bilbo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1437-1558-5184-5401.description:
Cast Xorn by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Xorn spell three times.
Resolve all Xorn spells.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bilbo.
Bilbo's second ability triggers, creating five Treasure tokens due to the four Xorns.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 4 each turn.

1578-1887-2845-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, blinking Quintorius Kand, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Quintorius Kand's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it, exiling Manamorphose and Flicker from your graveyard with the ability to cast them this turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Cast Manamorphose from exile by paying {1}{R/G}.
Quintorius Kand triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve Manamorphose, adding {1}{W} and causing you to draw a card.
Cast Flicker from exile by paying {1}{W}.
Quintorius Kand triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand, causing it to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Repeat from step 2.

2051-2546-4067-4566.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-4067-4566.description:
Activate Barren Moor's cycling ability by paying {B} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Barren Moor ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, creature or land.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Barren Moor and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1467-1770-2103-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-1770-2103-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

579-1194-2645.notablePrerequisites: Knotvine Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
579-1194-2645.description:
Activate Knotvine Mystic by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Knotvine Mystic.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

512-3990-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Halo Fountain and Incubation Druid do not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
512-3990-4694.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it and untapping it and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4881-5011-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cavalier of Night.
When Cavalier of Night dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

717-779-833-3263.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's second ability by paying {2} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2850-3575.notablePrerequisites:
Aeries Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
A creature with flying is on the battlefield.
2850-3575.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing it, targeting any creature with flying.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Aerie Ouphes enters the battlefield, triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Aerie Ouphes.
The +1/+1 counter and -1/-1 counter are removed as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, dealing an arbitrarily high amount of damage to any number of flying creatures.

109-1357-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
109-1357-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

570-2024-4858.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-2024-4858.description:
Cast Prismwake Merrow by paying {2}{U}.
Prismwake Merrow enters the battlefield, triggering itself, making a permanent you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
